## Notes

<!-- Maintained by discovery: one line per fact, "- `<glob>` — <fact>". dev-cycle never rewrites this section. -->
- `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` — plugin source is "./plugin", so only plugin/ ships; the root keeps tests/, docs/, README, CHANGELOG, LICENSE
- `tests/**` — node:test suite; helpers.mjs CLI_PATH/SCRIPTS_DIR via import.meta.url; docs tests read README/CHANGELOG and plugin/skills/ through rootFor
- `plugin/skills/**` — byte caps enforced by tests: orchestrator/SKILL.md at 18765 (zero headroom), playbook lifecycle.md ≤29105, quick.md ≤8192
- `plugin/scripts/lib/release.mjs` — ship --release auto-detects the marketplace manifest by following marketplace.json plugin sources (root `./plugin`); CHANGELOG.md is read at the project root
- `plugin/dashboard/**` — runtime root is projectRoot() = cwd/../.. or <DASHBOARD_FEATURES_DIR>/../..; run-dashboard.sh sets it and runs npm ci --omit=dev on first start
- `.dev-cycle/project.json` — its commands are pinned verbatim by tests/check.test.mjs (AC45); lint runs tests/lint-skills.sh with cwd = repo root
